scope: Exact-byte static release/firewall audit of the single declared stable efb093d/5a0d/c395 set. No repair-draft bytes, target values, production arrays, estimator calls, MC generation, fitting, or scoring were used.

frozen_hash_closure.finding: Every source and reference digest named by IMPLEMENTATION_MANIFEST_V2R1.json and IMPLEMENTATION_FREEZE_V2R1.json matched the exact bytes inspected.

artifact_durability_primitives.finding: artifact_io.py creates JSON/NPZ artifacts with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, file fsync, read-only chmod, and parent-directory fsync; it rejects symlinked parent components and paths outside the artifact root.

claim_before_semantic_open_design.finding: The orchestrator validates a stage release and writes a durable claim before stage-specific semantic work. Postrelease preclaim errors and postclaim errors have distinct append-only terminal paths.

official_target_last_authentication_desi.finding: After the durable official claim, official_target_last.py independently rehashes/parses the release, claim, response freeze, response payload, target manifest, and target bundle; it verifies the named endpoint arrays before decoding the single frozen row. It does not rely on caller-supplied in-memory predictions.

target_purity_and_fixed_panel.finding: Fit uses only the nine frozen observer_fit physical-state rows. Held MC and response stages are target-free. Official all_layer_means is last and row-filtered. All four fixed contractual rows must pass individually; the aggregate MC standard error is explicitly conditional for the fixed panel and makes no population claim.

provider_and_statistical_spelling.finding: The native20/e2/uV/u3/u4/total4 capture seam inventory, corrected source-zero parent, two 16x500000 MC streams, raw block retention, independent A/B cross-residual oracle-capacity gate, delete-one-block jackknife, conventional per-stream guards, and diagnostic-only nonlinear EDG2 statistic match the frozen protocol.

static_arithmetic_census.finding: The arithmetic census is consistent for the declared endpoint correction circuit. The separate 256 KiB streaming claim remains explicitly unproved.

qualifications_not_credited_as_passes.streaming_256k: The implementation explicitly records streaming_256k_claim_proven=false; the all-layer capture path is not a streaming deployment receipt.
qualifications_not_credited_as_passes.resource_scope: The metered callable computes the corrected parent and fused endpoint response but returns only the 1024-coordinate final endpoint. This is sufficient for the current final-output family; it is not evidence of a byte-identical full (16,1024) public-return assembly if such an API claim is later made.
qualifications_not_credited_as_passes.rss_scope: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) gives an absolute current-process peak. It is not a descendant-process RSS proof; no descendant process is presently part of the declared CPU path.
qualifications_not_credited_as_passes.population_inference: The four rows are fixed contractual cases. The reported square-root-sum variance divided by four is conditional MC uncertainty only and cannot support an unseen-network or population claim.

release_disposition.reason: The source graph and intended data firewall are largely coherent, but the exact frozen byte set cannot lawfully and numerically complete its one-shot chain until all eleven defects are repaired and rebound in one immutable replacement set.

required_r1_acceptance_tests: One new immutable manifest/freeze/static-verification set; do not patch the declared stable set in place.
A successful synthetic official transaction authenticates the deploy resource digest and reaches result construction.
The held-semantic exact permission map both authorizes its meter and rejects unknown permission keys.
Direct trainer-versus-deploy head parity passes under the exact frozen dtype/order.
A syntactically valid HOLD audit is rejected before fit claim.
A postclaim fit-release mutation/splice is rejected downstream.
The old seed clauses are explicitly superseded by the corrected eight-receipt authority.
All static fixtures pass under the exact pinned runtime and the receipt binds that runtime.
MODEL_HASH_FREEZE binds the contract-required complete modified-estimator resource receipt.
An early future PANEL_CONTINUATION_RELEASE blocks current-row official target access.
Independent Cubic, Direct, and H4 audits parse as PASS before a fit claim can exist.
